sources.entry: MacPacker - Archive manager for macOS. Preview (nested) archives without extracting them. Extract single files.

summary.one_liner: MacPacker is a free, open source macOS archive manager that lets you browse, preview, and selectively extract files from 40+ archive and disk image formats, and create or edit ZIP and 7z archives.
summary.what_it_does: Lets you browse archive contents like folders without extracting them, and drill into nested archives in the app and in Quick Look. You can drag out only the files you need via drag and drop. It reads and extracts 40+ formats including archives, disk images, and compression containers, and detects formats by magic number rather than extension. It can create ZIP and 7z archives, optionally with AES-256 passwords and split into volumes, and can add, replace, and delete files in ZIP and 7z archives. Finder integration adds right-click extract and compress actions, and Quick Look previews archive contents with the spacebar. It preserves Finder tags, custom icons, permissions, and symbolic links.
use_cases: extract a single file from a large archive
preview files inside a zip or rar
edit files inside an existing zip archive
open disk images and ISO files on a Mac
how_to_run: Or download the .dmg or .zip from macpacker.app or GitHub Releases and move the app to Applications
Building from source: git clone --recurse-submodules <repo URL> && cd MacPacker
Build and run in Xcode with Cmd + R
notable: Browse nested archives in the app and Quick Look without intermediate extraction
Reads 40+ formats including disk images, tarballs, and split archives
Creates and edits ZIP and 7z archives with AES-256 passwords and volume splitting
Preserves Finder tags, custom icons, permissions, and symlinks so extracted apps still launch
caveats: Requires macOS 14.6 or later (macOS 13 supported only through v0.14.1)
Building from source requires Xcode 26 or later and git submodules
Mac App Store builds arrive a few days after GitHub and direct downloads
